name: SL-M980-B-I control pair
weight_description: Calculated pair weight: 98 g (SL-M980-B-IL) + 103 g (SL-M980-B-IR) = 201 g, using Shimano’s published individual-unit average weights. I-spec B controls for 10-speed rear shifting and selectable 2/3-chainring front shifting, without optical gear displays. Cable/housing inclusion is not specified. This revision is distinct from the original SL-M980.
